title: Private Credential
description: A user-held credential and its current lifecycle state.

subject.description: Identifier of the subject that owns the credential.

issuer.description: Identifier of the authority that issued the credential.

role.description: Business role asserted by the issuer.

expiry.description: Credential expiry as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

credentialId.description: Unique identifier assigned to the credential.

status.description: Lifecycle state used by the credential holder and validation fixtures.
